alignments.note: Verb with subject pronoun; margin's The pastures ... do drop read and set aside (rule 38).
Construct noun construed as a locative adverbial accusative of the intransitive drop takes the supplied upon (rule 33) and the (rule 29); it is not the verb's object.
Rectum takes of and supplied the (rules 19, 15).
גִּיל is the bare direct object of חָגַר (gird on X); the noun keeps only its own word, the with being the passive English verb's reach to that object (rules 33 direct-object question, 44).
Supplied the belongs to the noun (rule 15).

Verb recast as passive with auxiliary (rule 17); the supplied with by which the English verb reaches its bare direct object joins the verb's unit under rule 44, as טָחוּ תָּפֵל → daubed ... with untempered mortar does, discontinuous from nothing here. Competing reading gave with to the noun under rule 33 as an instrumental adjunct.

review_notes: with moved from גִּיל to the passive verb: the noun is חָגַר's direct object, so rule 33's direct-object question sends the supplied preposition to rule 44.
